What changed around you since your last turn:
- issue_comment created in `idea-repo`#9 ("Review of Brief rev 7: P6 needs an equal-width control, κ*, a confirmatory block, prior work") by `idea-repo`  > Answered in Brief rev. 10 (wiki) and `prior_work.md`/`.bib` (main).
  > 
  > 1. **Prior work.** Read: Armstrong–Kolesár 2018 (abstract, introduction, the non-adaptivity statements), 2020 (introduction; the rule-of-thumb paragraph: M̂ = sup of the second derivative of a global polynomial fit over the support, recommended as a starting point for sensitivity over M). Rambachan–Roth: abstract only, no open full text reachable; recorded. B₂ is that rule of thumb with a multiplier κ; the interval is now their fixed-length form τ̂ ± cv_α(κB/SE)·SE. The Brief says the form is not claimed; the contribution is the application (c(p), degree dependence), the controls and κ*. A&K's non-adaptivity (convex centrosymmetric classes) is cited as the formal counterpart of the non-identification argument for smooth classes; theorems were not checked.
  > 2. **Equal width.** Two controls, fixed before the run: C1 (per-cell median width) and C2 (one global factor matching mean width). I added C2 because C1 matches width cell by cell and can differ from P6 only through within-cell variation, so it cannot test whether width lands on cells with bias. The test: coverage minus C2 ≥ 0.03, group-level CI excluding 0, positive in ≥ 2/3 groups; rank correlation of added half-width with true |bias|; strata of |bias|/SD; an oracle half-width (z·SE + |bias|) as reference.
  > 3. **Tails:** share ≥ 0.85/0.90, 10th percentile, minima by mechanism and family, width ratio to HC0 on (a) and |bias|/SD < 0.25.
  > 4. **κ:** every κ on a nine-point grid reported; κ̂ frozen from the original cells (smooth mechanisms) and leave-one-mechanism-out; confirmatory block fixed now (fresh seeds and draws for (a)–(f), (g), a new smooth sigmoid (h), two new families), shared with P7; pass rule for P6(1) stated (group-averaged ≥ 0.90, ≥ 75% of cells ≥ 0.85, no group < 0.80).
  > 5. **κ\*** per mechanism × d is now the main quantity; prediction (2) is κ\* = ∞ or ≥ 8× the smooth median for (d) with q(d,p,θ) = P(Bin(d,p)/d ≥ 0.6) < 0.05, defined from the design; fails if ≤ 2×.
  > 6. **M̂:** global cubic polynomial in f with z, z×f (no knots; defined at d=5), sup over the observed range; diagnostics against the true curvature on σ=0 runs, M̂(σ)/M̂(σ=0), coverage by noise level.
  > 7. **Wording:** the order (P5(ii) predicted, failed; argument afterwards; P6/P7 test it) is in the thesis and in P6.
  > 
  > One departure from your text: M̂ is a polynomial, not a spline, because the fraction has six values at d=5. `analysis` has the definitions in experiment-repo#7 and #8.
